sentences.text: A Tier 3 UCB’s no-charge rule for business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises covers sanctioned amounts or limits up to ₹50 lakh, and the case loan is ₹80 lakh, so that specific no-charge condition is not met.
For term loans, if a pre-payment charge is levied by a UCB, it must be based on the amount being prepaid.

The evidence does not show a rule that clearly answers whether a Tier 3 UCB may levy a pre-payment charge on this ₹80 lakh loan beyond the ₹50 lakh no-charge threshold, so I cannot confirm a yes or no from the materials provided.
